title: HowToDirection
description: A direction indicating a single action to do in the instructions for how to achieve a result.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

afterMedia.title: After Media
afterMedia.description: A media object representing the circumstances after performing this direction.

beforeMedia.title: Before Media
beforeMedia.description: A media object representing the circumstances before performing this direction.

duringMedia.title: During Media
duringMedia.description: A media object representing the circumstances while performing this direction.

performTime.title: Perform Time
performTime.description: The length of time it takes to perform instructions or a direction (not including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

prepTime.title: Prep Time
prepTime.description: The length of time it takes to prepare the items to be used in instructions or a direction, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

supply.title: Supply
supply.description: A sub-property of instrument. A supply consumed when performing instructions or a direction.

supply_text.title: Supply (text)
supply_text.description: A sub-property of instrument. A supply consumed when performing instructions or a direction.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.

tool_text.title: Tool (text)
tool_text.description: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.

totalTime.title: Total Time
totalTime.description: The total time required to perform instructions or a direction (including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).
